items.title: Podman 镜像检查点混淆致提权
items.title_zh: Podman 镜像检查点混淆致提权
items.summary_zh: 攻击者用特制镜像/检查点控制容器执行方式,可能突破隔离在宿主机执行
items.repro_note: 入口 podman run,需可提交镜像或检查点,构造混淆参数
items.impact_scope: 容器运行时,影响宿主与多租户
items.description: This allowed easy transfer of checkpoints between systems. Conflating container images and checkpoints in `podman run` allows inherently insecure behavior as the image can now control how it is executed.

items.title: Argo CD 授权错误致权限提升
items.title_zh: Argo CD 授权错误致权限提升
items.summary_zh: 已认证低权限用户可借授权缺陷越权操作Argo CD资源,可能控制应用部署
items.action_zh: 升级到 3.3.15 并审计RBAC配置
items.repro_note: 入口 Argo CD API/UI,需有效账户,调用越权接口
items.impact_scope: K8s GitOps平台,可影响集群部署
items.description: ### Credits The Argo CD team would like to thank @RealFakeAccount, @AdamKorcz, @0xshylines, @thevilledev, @HenriWilliams, @cherez0ff, @ARSB1, and @zwindler for responsibly disclosing this issue according to our [security reporting guidelines](https://github.com/argoproj/argo-cd/blob/master/SECURITY.md#reporting-a-vulnerability).

items.title: KEDA 越权读取Secret致集群提权
items.title_zh: KEDA 越权读取Secret致集群提权
items.summary_zh: 命名空间管理员利用KEDA越权读集群Secret并创建Job,提权为集群管理员
items.repro_note: 入口 KEDA ScaledObject/TriggerAuth,前置命名空间管理员权限
items.impact_scope: K8s集群组件,可致集群接管
items.description: This is effectively privilege escalation from namespace admin to cluster admin in real environments: a cluster-wide Secret read alone is enough to find a token for a more privileged ServiceAccount, and the cluster-wide `batch/jobs` create lets the attacker run a workload in any namespace whose Pod Security Admission level permits it (or that is PSA-exempt, such as `kube-system` , `kyverno`) to reach the node filesystem and a control-plane kubeconfig.

items.title: EnergizeLab中间件 任意文件读取
items.title_zh: EnergizeLab中间件 任意文件读取
items.summary_zh: 任意已注册低权限账户可传入恶意路径读取服务器文件,泄露中间件与密钥
items.action_zh: 暂无官方修复信息,限制账户权限与文件访问
items.repro_note: 入口文件路径参数,前置低权限登录,传入../遍历路径
items.impact_scope: 机器人中间件Docker服务,内网部署
items.description: EnergizeLab station-middleware (NestJS) Docker images 1.6.5 through 1.8.2 allow any registered, low-privilege account to read arbitrary files from the server by supplying an attacker-controlled file path. This exposes middleware files and server secrets.

items.title: Eilik FastAPI 未授权模型管理
items.title_zh: Eilik FastAPI 未授权模型管理
items.summary_zh: 未认证远程攻击者可修改AI模型配置并在运行时切换模型,导致推理被篡改
items.action_zh: 暂无官方修复信息,限制管理服务网络访问
items.repro_note: 入口 FastAPI 管理接口,无需认证,调用模型配置变更端点
items.impact_scope: AI机器人推理服务,局域网暴露
items.description: The EnergizeLab Eilik and EilikO FastAPI AI inference and profiling services expose AI model administration functions without authentication. An unauthenticated remote attacker can change AI model configuration and switch the model in use at runtime.

items.title: Jooan摄像头 硬编码凭据RCE
items.title_zh: Jooan摄像头 硬编码凭据RCE
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者利用固件硬编码凭据登录,以root权限执行任意命令
items.action_zh: 暂无官方修复信息,隔离摄像头网络并修改默认凭据
items.repro_note: 入口摄像头管理端口,使用硬编码凭据登录后执行命令
items.impact_scope: IP摄像头,常暴露于网络边界
items.description: Jooan JA-A12 IP cameras with firmware 009_20171107 and 05.02.31.105 contain a remote code execution vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to run root commands via hard-coded credentials. Attackers send singleCMD=SetDiagMode to /goform/SingleHandlebyCommand with an attacker-chosen authserverip and authcode, making the jooandiag daemon execute their commands through /bin/sh, giving full device control.

items.title: Archon 控制API未授权RCE
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者可访问绑定0.0.0.0的/api控制接口,驱使AI代理在宿主机执行命令
items.action_zh: 暂无官方修复信息,限制8090等API端口访问
items.repro_note: 入口 /api/* 控制接口,默认0.0.0.0,无需认证发消息
items.impact_scope: AI编码代理服务,开发/内网主机
items.description: Archon 0.2.13 through 0.11.1 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to access the /api/* control API, which binds to 0.0.0.0 by default. Attackers with network access can send messages to the AI coding agent, which runs with bypassPermissions, to execute commands on the host as the Archon user.

items.title: JuggleIM 默认管理员凭据
items.summary_zh: 攻击者用默认admin/123456登录8090管理台,即使账户删除也会被重建,可控制租户
items.action_zh: 暂无官方修复信息,修改默认密码并限制管理台访问
items.repro_note: 入口 8090管理控制台,使用admin/123456默认凭据登录
items.impact_scope: IM服务管理后台,可控制租户密钥
items.description: JuggleIM im-server through 1.8.16 ships default administrator credentials admin/123456 that allow unauthenticated remote attackers to access the admin console on port 8090. Attackers can log in as administrator, even after account deletion since CheckLogin recreates it, to control tenant applications and app secrets.
